model: Symmetra single-phase UPS with Network Management Card 2 (BACnet IP)
applies_to: APC Symmetra single-phase UPS units fitted with a Network Management Card 2 running the 'sy' application firmware 6.5.6 or later.
summary: The Network Management Card 2 in a single-phase Symmetra UPS serves BACnet IP with a fixed object map: Analog Values for runtime, battery, input, output and early-shutdown settings, Binary Values for test commands, option enables and UPS alarm flags, Character String Values for identity text, and Multi-state Values for UPS state, UPS control, self-test schedule and probe status.
notes: Instances follow the map's Index column; the BACnet ID column is the full object identifier (type x 4194304 + instance) and agrees with it.
Multi-state option lists are given in printed order; the map does not print state numbers.
Objects marked ** need an AP9631/AP9635 card with a Universal I/O probe on port 1, and those marked with a dagger a probe on port 2; the marks are removed from the names here.
Alarm flag BVs send event notifications to the recipients in NC 0 DefaultNotifier.
Some names are printed with typos (e.g. 'Ouput load current'); kept as printed.

source.title: Network Management Card 2 BACnet Application Map for Symmetra (Single Phase) UPS v6.5.6 and higher

integration.summary: Enable BACnet on the NMC2 ('sy' firmware 6.5.6+) and give it a unique device instance. Read UPS state (MV 3), runtime (AV 0), battery charge (AV 38), output voltage and current, and the alarm flags such as OnBattery and LowBattery. UPS Control (MV 4) can switch the UPS off, so restrict who can write it.

minimum_points.name: UPS state
minimum_points.why: Online, on battery, bypass, fault and so on

setup: BACnet IP only; configure BACnet (enable, device instance) on the NMC2, see the NMC2 User Guide.
Add the BMS as a recipient of NC 0 DefaultNotifier to receive alarm events.
gotchas: Writing MV 4 UPS Control can switch off the protected load.
BV 0-2 start real UPS tests (self test, alarm test, runtime calibration).
Universal I/O probe objects exist only with an AP9631/AP9635 card and a probe fitted.
